title: Profit crafting
subtitle: Crafts for every budget in 3.30, from day 1 flasks to mirror-tier items
summary: Pick the tier that matches your bankroll and move up as it grows. On day 1, craft cheap things levelers need. From day 2 or 3, switch to batch crafts like Rog items and medium cluster jewels. In week 2, put real money into fossils and Eldritch implicits. Influence and mirror-tier crafts come later, once you have hundreds of divines.

phases.crafts: Flasks, MS boots, resistance jewellery, Vaal gem corruptions
phases.why: Everyone is leveling and gear is scarce

phases.crafts: Rog crafts from Expedition, essence boots and belts
phases.why: Your atlas already farms the materials

phases.crafts: Medium cluster jewels, +1/+2 caster wands, RF gloves and boots
phases.why: Steady demand from builds that are already working

changes.title: More good drops
changes.body: Endgame rares now drop unidentified with a tier, and rarity improves every type of drop. Plain 3-mod rares lose value faster, so craft items that drops can't easily replace.

changes.title: Bench locks cost divines
changes.body: Locking prefixes or suffixes costs 1 div per side, and locking everything costs 4 div plus a Sacred, Blessed or Exalted. Only metacraft items that sell for many divines.

changes.title: Fewer fractured and veiled items
changes.body: Most league sources of fractured items are gone, and veiled mods now only come from Betrayal. Avoid crafts that depend on them in week 1.

changes.title: Cheaper Vaal Orbs
changes.body: The Vaal Orb recipe now needs only 5 Vaal gems, so corruption gambling should get better value.

crafts.name: Utility flasks
steps: Transmute, then alteration and augment spam until you hit a useful suffix
Add quality with Glassblower's Baubles
Bench craft the finish
crafts.targets: A useful suffix (movement speed on Quicksilver, Onslaught on Silver, bleed or freeze immunity) plus a duration or effect prefix, at 20% quality

crafts.name: Movement-speed boots
crafts.base: Any boots with life or ES
steps: Vendor recipe: magic boots + Quicksilver Flask + Orb of Augmentation adds movement speed
Essence or bench craft resistances
Bench craft life if a prefix is open
crafts.targets: 20%+ movement speed, life or ES, 2 resistances

crafts.name: Resistance rings and belts
crafts.base: Amethyst rings, Leather or Heavy belts
steps: Chaos reforge, or use the bench craft that rerolls 3 mods for 3 Chaos Orbs
Bench craft the missing resistance

crafts.name: Vaal gem corruptions
steps: Open the Gem Vaal & levelling tab
Vaal only the gems it marks as positive EV
Sell 21/20s quickly while the skill is popular
crafts.buyers: Players buying perfect gems for their main skill

crafts.name: Rog crafting (Expedition)
crafts.base: ilvl 84+ rings, belts and evasion helmets (best). Evasion boots and evasion/armour gloves next
steps: Fill suffixes with Rog's adding option, leaving a prefix open for bench-crafted life
Reroll the side you're targeting and always take tier upgrades
Use Divine near the end, once the item looks good
Bench craft the missing life, or annul a bad mod to make room
Don't skip options without thinking: skipping raises the artifact cost and can force an option that bricks the item
crafts.targets: Life, resistances and attributes on jewellery; spell suppression with resistances or life on helmets, boots and gloves
crafts.buyers: Everyone rounding out resistances and suppression
crafts.note: Run logbooks at ilvl 75+ with 65%+ quantity, and spend explosives on artifact chests first. Rog needs character level 90 to offer ilvl 86+ bases.

crafts.name: Medium cluster jewels
crafts.base: Medium Cluster Jewels at the item level the notables need
crafts.cost: About 70c each, 5 div for a batch of 30
steps: Check poe.ninja Builds on day 2 or 3 for the notables the top skills use
Alteration until you hit a wanted notable
Regal, then exalt for the second notable
Price check anything with 2 used notables
crafts.targets: 2 notables a popular build uses (for the Cold DoT archetype, cold and DoT clusters)
crafts.buyers: Builds that have already found their feet
crafts.note: A 3.29 test crafted 30 jewels at about 70c each and sold them for about 8,600c, a profit of roughly 6,000c.

crafts.name: +1/+2 caster wands
steps: Alteration for +1 cold spell gems or DoT multiplier
Regal
Bench finish (4-second trigger craft or spell damage)
crafts.targets: +1/+2 cold spell gems, DoT multiplier, spell damage
crafts.buyers: Every cold DoT and spell build, including yours

crafts.name: RF gloves and boots
crafts.base: ilvl 85 gloves with high base percentile
crafts.sale: 50c to 1 div, a few big hits
steps: Essence spam
Fill the open slots with exalts
Annul bad mods
Bench Fire and Chaos resistance
Batch the prefixes across a stack of gloves
crafts.buyers: Righteous Fire players (RF Chieftain is S-tier on 3.30 league-start lists)
crafts.note: bLut's 3.29 method, at 40 to 50 gloves an hour. These figures come from a video summary and are approximate.

estimate.per: per pair, base and essences not included

crafts.name: Max-resistance ES body armour
crafts.base: High item level Twilight Regalia (about 20c for the base)
crafts.cost: About 12 div per finished chest at 3.29 prices
crafts.sale: 20 to 60+ div for +2% max res with high ES
steps: Roll energy shield prefixes first (essences or a Dense Fossil), keeping a good ES base
Use Grand Eldritch Embers until the +% to all maximum Resistances implicit lands
Finish the open slots with Exalted Orbs or bench crafts
crafts.targets: +1 to +2% to all maximum resistances implicit, high ES, physical taken as chaos
crafts.buyers: Every ES build, including the Cold DoT Occultist
crafts.note: A 3.29 planner craft of this chest came to about 11.7 div all in. The Ember count depends on luck.

crafts.name: Fossil ES spirit shields
steps: Put Dense Fossils in Primitive Chaotic Resonators and reroll the shield
Stop when you hit 2 to 3 energy shield prefixes
Bench craft the missing ES prefix or quality, then finish suffixes with resistances
crafts.targets: 2 to 3 high ES prefixes, spell block, resistances
crafts.buyers: Caster and ES builds that use a shield

crafts.name: Abyssal socket gear
crafts.base: High item level helmets, gloves or boots for Intelligence stackers
steps: Reroll the base with a Hollow Fossil to get an abyssal socket
Keep items that also roll the stat you're after (Intelligence, ES, resistances)
Finish with exalts or bench crafts
crafts.targets: Abyssal socket plus Intelligence and energy shield
crafts.buyers: Intelligence stackers and abyss jewel builds

crafts.name: Double-influence gear (Awakener's Orb)
crafts.base: A donor with a single influence mod and a receiver of another influence, ilvl 86+
steps: Prepare a donor with exactly one influence mod, and a receiver of a different influence with the mod you want
Use the Awakener's Orb on the donor (it's destroyed), then apply it to the receiver
The receiver keeps one random influence mod from each item, so set up reset points first
Optional: use an Orb of Dominance to elevate one influence mod. It removes another at random
crafts.targets: Classic pairs: Hunter spell crit with Redeemer aura effect on Vaal Regalia, or elevated resistances with elevated attack crit on armour
crafts.note: Awakener's Orbs only drop from Sirus, so supply is thin. A donor with more than one influence mod makes the carried mod random.

crafts.name: Exceptional Eldritch implicits
crafts.base: Already-good rare helmets, gloves and boots on popular bases
steps: Buy finished rares with good explicit mods but weak implicits
Use Exceptional Eldritch Embers and Ichors to roll top implicits
Resell, or keep the item for your own build
crafts.targets: Top-tier Exarch and Eater implicits that suit the item's build

crafts.name: Mirror-tier items and mirror services
crafts.base: A double-elevated or otherwise near-perfect base
crafts.sale: Mirrors, or a fee per copy as a mirror service
steps: Start from a top base (two elevated influence mods or the best fracture you can buy)
Finish the open mods with bench locks (1 div per side in 3.30) and exalts, aiming for 6 top-tier mods
Add Exceptional Eldritch implicits
Mirror it once and list the copy, or offer it as a mirror service and charge a fee per copy
crafts.targets: Six top-tier mods plus top implicits for a meta build
crafts.buyers: The richest players in the league
crafts.note: Not a week 1 project. Plan for it once you have 500+ div and know which builds will be meta late in the league.

avoid: Most league sources are gone, so the bases cost more than the crafts return in week 1.
Veiled mods now only come from Betrayal, so supply is thin early on.
Prefix or suffix locks cost 1 div each now. Only use them on items worth 10+ div.
Mercenaries were nerfed, and demand for their claws, chests and shields will drop.
Tiered drops make decent rares much more common. Craft specific combinations instead.
Big Eldritch and recombinator projects on day 1
Expensive and thin at the start. Wait until prices settle around day 4 or 5.
selling: Look up the cheapest 5 to 10 comparable items and list just under them.
Prices on almost everything fall as supply grows, so take today's price.
Set them and wait 30 to 60 minutes for better rates on essences and exalts.
Log each batch on the Portfolio tab so you can see which craft earns the most per hour.
Drop a craft when its margin goes
If a stack hasn't sold within a few hours, cut the price and move on.
